title: Bought a FJZ80 in the midst of a 1HZ swap, some questions
transmission: A442F automatic (rebuilt, Australian-sourced Wholesale Automatics valve body and torque converter)
ai_summary: New owner acquired an FZJ80 mid-conversion from a previous owner's partially completed 1HZ swap with an Australian-sourced A442F automatic transmission build, and is asking the forum to help finish the job. Outstanding items included wiring for tach/speedo signal sourcing, glow plug relay/timer setup, missing A/C components, and an unclear kickdown cable connection between the injection pump and A442 transmission; the original 1FZ-FE radiator was deemed adequate for cooling.

complications.detail: Tach signal source unclear (injection pump vs fuel pump); speedometer needed conversion using original T-case electronic sensor
Project inherited partially complete from previous owner, with air intake, driveshafts, coolant plumbing, and A/C still needing installation
Kickdown cable from the A442F automatic lacked a clear connection point on the diesel injection pump
